translations.source_sense_description: attributiv: aus Zedernholz bestehend oder gemacht

glosses: A coniferous tree of the genus Cedrus in the family Pinaceae.
A coniferous tree of the family Cupressaceae, especially of the genera Juniperus, Cupressus, Calocedrus, or Thuja.

examples.text: There had been dry seasons, accumulations of dust, wind-blown seeds, and cedars rose wonderfully out of solid rock.

glosses: A flowering tree of the family Meliaceae, especially of the genera Cedrela or Toona.
The aromatic wood from a Cedrus tree, or from any of several not closely related trees.
พหูพจน์ของ Zeder
